content.title: The Masters 2025: Dates and Schedule
content.text: Dates for The Masters 2025:April 10th to 13th (Thursday to Sunday)The 2025 Masters marks the 89th edition of this prestigious event, which is one of the four major championships in men’s professional golf and serves as the opening major of the year. Established in 1934, The Masters was co-founded by Bobby Jones and has since become renowned for its rich history and tradition.The Masters committee is responsible for determining the groupings and tee times for participating golfers. These pairings are typically announced the week of the event, usually on the Tuesday preceding the first round, allowing fans and players alike to anticipate the matchups. For more information on tee times and pairings, please refer to the Masters Tee Times and Pairings page. Additionally, details on how golfers qualify for the Masters can be found here.Schedule for The Masters 2025:Sunday, April 6: Player arrivals and practice roundsMonday, April 7: Player arrivals and practice roundsTuesday, April 8: Practice rounds and the Champions DinnerWednesday, April 9: Practice rounds and the Par-3 ContestThursday, April 10: Honorary starters ceremony followed by the first round of the Masters.Friday, April 11: Second round of the eventSaturday, April 12: Third round of the eventSunday, April 13: Fourth and final round of the event, followed by the Green Jacket ceremony and trophy presentationThe Masters 2025 is not just a competition; it’s an experience steeped in tradition and excitement. We look forward to witnessing the world’s best golfers compete for the coveted green jacket amidst the picturesque setting.
